title: A largest perfectoid-purity center and normal quotient for perfectoid-pure complete local rings with perfect positive-characteristic residue field
author: Anne Fayolle
difficulty_reason: The formal existence of a maximal compatible ideal does not by itself supply a canonical center with a normal quotient in mixed characteristic. The author develops compatibility under perfectoidization and quotient maps, proves independence from the chosen regular presentation, and shows that the normalization conductor is uniformly compatible. Those new transfer/conductor arguments close purity detection, canonical splitting-prime maximality and normality beyond the precise prior perfectoid/prism foundations.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Complete Noetherian local ring with perfect residue field of characteristic p>0. Splitting ideal beta is proper exactly when R is perfectoid pure; in this case it is the largest perfectoid-purity center and R/beta is a normal domain. Full iterative core Definition6.2 and compatibility/maximality proof26–27, quotient compatibility8–9, normalization independence10–13, conductor perfectoid pullback22–23 and ideal operations14–15 read. Named Bhatt–Scholze perfectoidization and Andre flatness are traced background; no independent reproof. Original restriction perfect residue field retained from introductory TheoremD, although Proposition6.7 uses broader Notation2.10. No positive-characteristic or etale parameter variants counted.

historical_source_pdf_evidence.original_difficulty_reason: The author constructs a descending compatible-ideal core through perfectoidization and proves its maximality and purity detection, with a conductor pullback argument yielding normality of the quotient. This mixed-characteristic perfectoid singularity theory exceeds qualifying-exam commutative algebra.
